rows.quote: We used the latest release data on VTE from the FinnGen study R12 in this analysis, which comprised 26,333 cases 474,015 controls.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the FinnGen study R12 release as the outcome data; the paper's own METAL meta-analysis with the other outcome GWAS is not one of the FinnGen meta-analysis rows.

rows.quote: GWAS data for VTE were assessed from UK biobank database (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/studies/GCST90038607) [14].
rows.coder_note: The sentence names a GWAS Catalog accession (GCST90038607) attributed to reference 14; no dictionary row carries that accession or that source.
The stated N (54,306) is the sample size of no candidate row, the platform alone does not identify a release, and reference 12 is the source of several candidate rows.

rows.quote: Comparatively, the deCODE Health study employed SomaScan platform to measure 4,907 proteomic aptamers in 35,559 Icelandic individuals, identifying instrumentally valid cis-SNPs for 1,423 plasma proteins [13].
rows.coder_note: Exact N 35,559 Icelandic individuals with the SomaScan platform (4,907 aptamers) matches one candidate row; the other deCODE row has a different N.
